[SWS_DM_01228] Mandatory sub functions
⌈
If one of the following
sub functions of DiagnosticAuthentication, DiagnosticServiceInstance
is configured:
• DiagnosticVerifyCertificateUnidirectional
• DiagnosticVerifyCertificateBidirectional
• DiagnosticProofOfOwnership
the Diagnostic Manager shall mandatorily require the following sub functions to be
configured as well:
• DiagnosticDeAuthenticate
• DiagnosticAuthenticationConfiguration
⌋
